import core::option;

fn before() -> i32 { return 1; }

pub enum GridCellsResume { Next }
pub machine GridCells on GridCellsResume -> core::option::Option<i32> {
    rows: i32,
    cols: i32,
    start Start;
    state Start {
        GridCellsResume::Next -> { let rows: i32 = self.rows; let cols: i32 = self.cols; let r: i32 = 0;
    while (r < rows) {
        let c: i32 = 0;
        if (r == 3) { goto Done with core::option::None(); } else { goto Yield0(r, c) with core::option::Some(0 - 1); }
        while (c < cols) {
            goto Yield1(r, c) with core::option::Some(r * 10 + c);
            c += 1;
        }
        r += 1;
    }
    goto Yield2(r) with core::option::Some(999); goto Done with core::option::None(); },
    }
    state Yield0(__lanius_gen_r: i32, __lanius_gen_c: i32) {
        GridCellsResume::Next -> { let rows: i32 = self.rows; let cols: i32 = self.cols; let r: i32 = __lanius_gen_r; { let c: i32 = __lanius_gen_c; {  } while (c < cols) {
            goto Yield1(r, c) with core::option::Some(r * 10 + c);
            c += 1;
        }
        r += 1; } while (r < rows) {
        let c: i32 = 0;
        if (r == 3) { goto Done with core::option::None(); } else { goto Yield0(r, c) with core::option::Some(0 - 1); }
        while (c < cols) {
            goto Yield1(r, c) with core::option::Some(r * 10 + c);
            c += 1;
        }
        r += 1;
    }goto Yield2(r) with core::option::Some(999); goto Done with core::option::None(); },
    }
    state Yield1(__lanius_gen_r: i32, __lanius_gen_c: i32) {
        GridCellsResume::Next -> { let rows: i32 = self.rows; let cols: i32 = self.cols; let r: i32 = __lanius_gen_r; { let c: i32 = __lanius_gen_c; { c += 1; } while (c < cols) {
            goto Yield1(r, c) with core::option::Some(r * 10 + c);
            c += 1;
        }r += 1; } while (r < rows) {
        let c: i32 = 0;
        if (r == 3) { goto Done with core::option::None(); } else { goto Yield0(r, c) with core::option::Some(0 - 1); }
        while (c < cols) {
            goto Yield1(r, c) with core::option::Some(r * 10 + c);
            c += 1;
        }
        r += 1;
    }goto Yield2(r) with core::option::Some(999); goto Done with core::option::None(); },
    }
    state Yield2(__lanius_gen_r: i32) {
        GridCellsResume::Next -> { let rows: i32 = self.rows; let cols: i32 = self.cols; let r: i32 = __lanius_gen_r;  goto Done with core::option::None(); },
    }
    final state Done {
        GridCellsResume::Next -> stay with core::option::None(),
    }
}
pub fn grid_cells(rows: i32, cols: i32) -> GridCells { return grid_cells_start(rows, cols); }
pub impl GridCells {
    pub fn next(&mut self) -> core::option::Option<i32> { return self.step(GridCellsResume::Next); }
}


fn between() -> i32 { return 2; }

enum OnceResume { Next }
machine Once on OnceResume -> core::option::Option<bool> {
    start Start;
    state Start {
        OnceResume::Next -> { goto Yield0 with core::option::Some(true); goto Done with core::option::None(); },
    }
    state Yield0 {
        OnceResume::Next -> {  goto Done with core::option::None(); },
    }
    final state Done {
        OnceResume::Next -> stay with core::option::None(),
    }
}
fn once() -> Once { return once_start(); }
impl Once {
    fn next(&mut self) -> core::option::Option<bool> { return self.step(OnceResume::Next); }
}


fn after() -> i32 { return 3; }
